tha-ap192:1.1: abhibhūtaṁ → abhibhūto (bj) | abhibhūtaṁ panijjhanti → abhibhuṁ theraṁ panijjhāma (sya-all) | panijjhanti → abhibhuṁ vopanijjhanti (bj: PTS) | panijjhanti → abhibhūtopanijjhanti (cck: sī.)
tha-ap192:1.2: mamaṁ → mayaṁ (sya-all) | mamaṁ → abhibhuṁ theraṁ panijjhāma sabbe saṅgamma te mayaṁ (bj: syā) | mamaṁ → abhibhuṁ theraṁ panijjhāma, sabbe saṅgamma te mayaṁ (cck: syā.)
